description: Documented repeatedly in clinical and academic settings: the man is introduced by title and the woman by first name, by the same speaker, in the same sentence.
energy_note: Introduced into a lower rank than you hold.

aspect: Correcting it is a bigger act than committing it
description: Saying 'it's Doctor' costs the speaker nothing and costs the corrector a reputation for standing on ceremony.
energy_note: Insisting on your own title is the rude part.

aspect: It is a microinsult in the technical sense
description: A communication conveying disrespect through a hidden message, frequently unintentional - which is what makes the pattern durable: nobody in the chain has to intend it for it to work every time.
energy_note: Nobody meant it, and it happened anyway.

description: Four speakers. The chair introduces Professor Adeyemi, Professor Lindqvist, Doctor Hassan, and 'and Maria, who's going to talk to us about the data'. Maria has the same doctorate as the other three.
energy_note: Three titles and a first name.
